source_basis: Official OKX listing announcements, CoinGecko distinct IDs, and user's 2026-11-08 Trader screenshot

records.ambiguity_warning: The symbol EDGE is also used by CoinGecko 'edge' (different project); never join by ticker alone.
records.explanation: EDGE-USDC appears in the user screenshot. Historic OKX announcements include EDGE-USDT, EDGE-USD and EDGE-EUR. After the official September 2026 migration, the historic EDGE-USD announcement is not proof of a currently listed EDGE-USD instrument. EDGE-USDC and the available tradeQuoteCcyList must be verified against current instrument data.
records.september_2026_usd_migration_review: EDGE-USD is a historical announcement; impact of the regional USD/USDC consolidation on this exact EDGE instrument is not independently established.

public_okx_migration.rule: Some Crypto-USD instruments were discontinued in favor of Crypto-USDC; do not assume an announced historical USD instrument is still available.
public_okx_migration.quote_note: USD may be in an instrument's account-specific tradeQuoteCcyList; USD and USDC are not equivalent accounting currencies.
